subject: science
name: Science
course: Life Science: Cellular Systems, Genetics & Ecology
title: Grade 7 Science: Life Science: Cellular Systems, Genetics & Ecology
overview: Grade 7 Science explores the interconnected systems of the physical, life, and Earth/space sciences using inquiry-based labs, computational modeling, and engineering design aligned with NGSS.
competencies: Formulate testable hypotheses, design empirical experiments, and interpret complex data graphs.
Construct and revise scientific models explaining matter, energy, and biological systems.
Apply mathematical relationships and physical laws to predict natural phenomena.
Evaluate technological solutions to ecological and societal challenges.

modules.title: From Molecules to Organisms: Cells and Body Systems
modules.description: Investigating cellular anatomy, plant vs. animal organelles, specialized cells, and hierarchical human body systems.

topics.title: Cell Theory and Organelle Functions
topics.description: Modeling the nucleus, mitochondria, cell membrane, and chloroplasts in cellular operations.

topics.title: Hierarchical Organization: Cells to Tissues to Organs
topics.description: Tracing interactions among circulatory, respiratory, nervous, and digestive systems in maintaining homeostasis.

modules.title: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits
modules.description: Modeling DNA genes on chromosomes, comparing asexual and sexual reproduction, and analyzing mutations.

topics.title: Reproduction: Asexual Cloning vs. Sexual Diversity
topics.description: Contrasting genetic uniformity in asexual reproduction with genetic diversity generated by sexual meiosis.

topics.title: Genes, Chromosomes and Genetic Mutations
topics.description: Analyzing how structural changes to genes (mutations) affect proteins and organismal traits.

modules.title: Ecosystems: Matter Cycles and Energy Transfers
modules.description: Constructing food webs, analyzing competitive and symbiotic relationships, and modeling carbon cycling in ecosystems.

topics.title: Interactions and Symbiosis in Communities
topics.description: Investigating mutualism, commensalism, parasitism, and resource competition in biological communities.

topics.title: Carbon and Energy Flow Through Trophic Levels
topics.description: Modeling how matter cycles through photosynthesis and cellular respiration in terrestrial/aquatic ecosystems.
